findings: Osaka city per-capita levy calculated for each ward and then totaled; Tokyo principal-ward combined prefectural/city handling must not be reused.

City corporation-tax levy rate depends on registered capital and nationwide preallocation levy base; eligible capital<=JPY100m and full-year base<=JPY20m use6%,otherwise8.2%. Liquidation and tax-trust exclusions require explicit handling.
Per-capita capital uses adjusted statutory capital with capital-plus-reserve floor; not registered capital alone.
City levy base precedes specified national credits; national final tax is not an interchangeable base.
implementation_remaining: Read prefectural surcharge periods, capital/income thresholds and2026 expanded size-based scope.
Verify filing rounding and short-year allocation in original return instructions.
Bind office/ward facts, local adjustments and component prepayments to saved national calculation.
Implement API/UI/report and restart/browser acceptance; Osaka is not nationwide Japan completion.
github_research: Targeted public Japan corporate local tax calculator search produced no suitable implementation reference; official city/prefecture sources determine rules. No external code or dependency adopted.

followup.surcharge_end_date: 2029-10-31 for enterprise and prefectural corporation-tax levy
followup.threshold_distinction: Enterprise uses preallocation income truncated belowJPY1000 against annualJPY50m (prorated for short years); prefectural corporation-tax levy uses preallocation national levy base against annualJPY20m. Capital and scope conditions remain separate.
followup.source_update: Old s6tebiki.pdf returns404. Current official download page links s6tebiki0807.pdf (R8.7) and seigo0806.pdf correcting R8.4. Both archived. Errata affects several credit/difference line references; use current instructions.
followup.remaining: Detailed current-return rounding and column mapping need review before calculation implementation. Image rate tables visually inspected; PDF text located but full visual/table review still pending.

enterprise_component.visual_review: Rendered R8.7 physical page7 and inspected band allocation before rounding, thousand-yen tax bases, hundred-yen band taxes.
enterprise_component.implementation: japan_osaka.ordinary_enterprise validates2026 start,1-12months, capital<=JPY100m and verified Osaka-only ordinary scope. Uses Osaka income thresholdJPY50m prorated by months after thousand-yen truncation. Reuses identical verified band arithmetic; outputs Osaka-only source records.
enterprise_component.validation: 11 tests passed in0.57s: standard/special levies,50m threshold and truncation, short-period bands, ambient precision, source hashes and rejected scope.
enterprise_component.limits: No saved-case/API/UI integration. Prefectural/city inhabitant and capitation, local adjustments, interim balances, and broader special/multi-location regimes remain required.

capitation_component.rules: Capital band=max(adjusted statutory capital,registered capital+reserve). Prefecture charged once; city annual capitation per established Osaka ward. Employee boundary50, distinct prefectural surcharge bands.
capitation_component.validation: 25 Osaka tests passed in0.61s, including14 new capitation cases covering capital tiers, reserve floor, per-ward employees, duplicate/empty scope, exact context and source hashes.
capitation_component.limits: Only verified full-year ordinary capital corporations in Osaka city; no short-year capitation, dormitory exemptions or other municipalities inferred. Inhabitant corporation-tax levies and complete saved workflow still pending.
